name: Salem Spooktacular 2023
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SalemSpooktacular2023#34137-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![Image description](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/published/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)
